title: Very weak, bags don’t have enough for 1 cup
text: Not a tea lover, we were given this as a gift.  We have tried many different kinds, some we actually couldn’t even drink after first sip.  For our tastes, these teas are much too weak and the flavors are very odd.  The amount given in plastic bag isn’t even enough for one cup of tea.  We have 2 boxes unopened and 3 boxes with several teas still untouched.  My opinion, this is not a very good way to try teas as it has completely turned me off to try any other boxes.  Maybe since I am a coffee drinker that is the problem.
label: negative
